name: Robots vs Aliens
short: Defend the city roads! Place robots in lanes to stop alien invaders. 180 levels.
full:
The aliens have landed and only your robots stand between them and the city. Robots vs Aliens is a lane-defence strategy game in the spirit of the classics.

Collect energy, place robots on the roads and hold every lane as waves of aliens march in. Mix economy robots, shooters, defenders and support units, and beat the bosses on the way to the finale against Commander Zorg.

CONTENT
- Campaign: 6 roads with 30 levels each - Downtown, Night Market, Harbor, Refinery, Overpass and the Landing Zone - told through short story cinematics. Boss fights at levels 10, 20 and 30.
- 49 robots and 31 aliens, unlocked as you play, with a full Almanac
- Survival mode (endless waves on every road), Quick Play and a Daily Challenge
- Mini-games: Conveyor, Bowling, Whack and Last Stand, plus 8 brain puzzles
- Workshop upgrades bought with coins, 25 achievements, a profile and options

FEATURES
- Polished 3D-baked sprites and animated cinematics
- Smooth touch controls made for phones and tablets
- Works offline, your progress is saved on your device

Free to play with ads. Made by Arcadoff.
